items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: I don't think that anywhere, there can be anywhere in the world that there were musicians like Noel as musicians.

ctx.x: That's been going on since the beginning of time. But the musicians themselves and the kind of music they played, well, that is the thing we're mostly interested in here right now. And I can only say one thing. I don't think that anywhere, there can be anywhere in the world that there were musicians like Noel as musicians. I'm not speaking as the picture of today. I don't think it's the same, do you think?
No, I think there are less musicians coming up.
